description: Happy dictation: office-wide network outage at the courier company, dictated post-visit from the van with the engine off. The technician narrates the incident with hours in words, adds four events to the timeline, two services (internal DNS and VPN), high severity and two follow-ups. Quiet environment, clear measured speech: every confirmation passes on the first try, no seeded errors.

turns.text: Can you hear me OK?... OK, I'm on my way out, in the van, just finished the network job at Kimsa... help me out with the incident report, alright?
turns.note: post-visit dictation in the van, engine off; quiet environment

turns.hint: get_incidente(IC-2003); recap the report (office-wide network outage at the Kimsa courier offices) and ask the technician to walk through what happened from the beginning.

turns.text: Well, the outage started early... around eight fifty reception called me that there was no internet in the whole office, no IP phones either... I went in to check and the core switch wasn't responding, the status LED just stayed orange.
turns.note: the operator's literal narrative; hour mentioned in passing, the timeline is asked for separately

turns.hint: set_que_paso with the technician's literal text; ask for the times in order to build the timeline.

turns.text: OK... the reception call was at eight fifty, log that one first.

turns.hint: agregar_evento_timeline(hora '08:50', evento 'Reception call reporting the office-wide network outage'); read the hour back out loud: 'eight fifty, confirm?'.

turns.text: That's it... then around nine fifteen I had it pinned to the core switch, because I tested it with the diagnostic kit and it wouldn't answer.
turns.note: first-try confirmation and a new event

turns.hint: agregar_evento_timeline(hora '09:15', evento 'Core switch identified as the cause after a diagnostic test'); read the hour back; ask for what comes next.

turns.text: At ten ten I put in the new spare switch I had with me... and by ten twenty I had the whole network back up, email and phones.
turns.note: two events in a single turn; hours in words

turns.hint: agregar_evento_timeline(hora '10:10', evento 'Core switch swapped for a spare unit'); agregar_evento_timeline(hora '10:20', evento 'Network restored: email and IP telephony back up'); read both hours back together; ask about the affected services.

turns.text: Well, the internal DNS went down, that was the first one... and the VPN too, because the delivery crew couldn't get into the system from the street.
turns.note: two services, neither confusable; clear speech

turns.hint: buscar_servicio('internal dns') resolves SRV-DNS-INTERNO with no confusables; agregar_servicio_afectado(SRV-DNS-INTERNO); read-back: 'internal dns server, correct?'.
buscar_servicio('vpn') resolves SRV-VPN-REMOTO; agregar_servicio_afectado(SRV-VPN-REMOTO); read-back: 'remote access vpn, correct?'; ask for the severity.

turns.text: Put it down as high... they went about an hour and a half without invoicing or shipping, that hurt.

turns.hint: set_severidad(high); ALWAYS read back: 'noting high severity, correct?'; once confirmed propose a one-line summary and ask for follow-ups.

turns.text: Yes, that's right... and leave two follow-ups: get me another spare switch to keep in the van, and tell the systems lead when they do the node maintenance.
turns.note: confirms severity on the first try and dictates two action items

turns.hint: agregar_action_item('Buy another spare switch to keep in the van'); agregar_action_item('Tell the systems lead when they do the node maintenance'); brief read-back of both; read the summary: 'Office-wide network outage from a failed core switch; network restored in an hour and a half with a spare switch.' and ask whether to send.

turns.text: That's fine... send it now, I've got another job waiting.

turns.hint: enviar_reporte(); confirm out loud 'incident form sent' and close the session.
